5.label: frg. 1 i
5.text: frg. 1 i

5.label: frg. 1 i
5.text: [… the souls of the slain] complain concerning their killing and cry out […].
5.sourceText: [-- נפשת קטי]לין קבלן על קטליהון ומזעקן

5.label: frg. 1 i
5.text: […] and we shall die together, and an end will be made […].
5.sourceText: [-- ]○תא ונמות כחדא ונתן שיציא

5.label: frg. 1 i
5.text: […] great wrath; and Ohyah slept and dreamed […].
5.sourceText: [-- ק]צ֯ף שגיא ואהוה דמך ולחם

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: Then the two of them dreamed dreams, and sleep departed from their eyes; they rose and opened their eyes.
5.sourceText: ונדת שנת[ ]עיניהון מנהון וק[מו ... ופ]ת֯ח֯ו עיניהון

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: They came to the assembly of their companions, the giants, and Hahyah said: “Men, in my dream this night I saw […].”
5.sourceText: ואתו על[ ... ]חלמיהון אשתעי^{ו֯} בכנשת ח[בריהון] נפיליא[ ואמר ההיה גברוא אנה ב]חלמי הוית חזא בליליא דן

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: A great garden was planted with every kind of tree, and it had gardeners who watered every tree in that garden continually.
5.sourceText: [גנתהה רבה הות נציבה בכל מיני עעין ו]ל[ה ]ה֯וא֯ ג֯ננין והוא משקין

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: Great roots went out from their trunks, and from one tree three roots went forth.
5.sourceText: [כל עע בגנתהה דא כל יומין ? ושר]ש֯י֯ן רברבין נפקו מן עקרה[ו]ן / [ומן עע חד נפקו תלתת שרשהי

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: I watched until tongues of fire came down from heaven.
5.sourceText: [... ]ה֯וית עד די לשנין די נור מן [שמין נחתו

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: I watched until the earth was covered with all the water, and fire burned throughout the trees of that whole garden.
5.sourceText: חזא הוית עד די אתכסי עפ]רא֯ בכל מיא ונורא דלק בכל֯ [עעי פרדסא דן כלה

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: The tree and its roots in the earth were not burned […], while [the rest] was destroyed by tongues of fire and by the waters of the flood. Here ends the dream.
5.sourceText: ולא דלק בעעא ושרשוהי ב]ארע֯א ... [מתאבדה בלשנין די נור ובמיא די מבול]א עד כא סוף חלמא

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: Then Hahyah asked them for the interpretation of his dream, but the men were unable to explain it to him.
5.sourceText: [באדין שאל להון ההיה פשר חלמה ולא ]השכחו גבריא לחויא לה

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Hahyah’s dream
5.text: They said that this dream should be given to Enoch, the distinguished scribe, so that he might interpret the dream for them.
5.sourceText: [... חל]מא דן ת֯נתן [לחנו]ך֯ לספר פרשא ויפשור לנא חלמא

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream
5.text: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream
5.text: Then Ohyah, his brother, answered and said before the men: “I too saw in my dream this night.”
5.sourceText: באד֯י֯ן[ ע]נ֯ה הווא אחוהי אוהיה ואמר קדם גבריא אף אנה חזית בחלמי בליליא דן

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream
5.text: Behold, the ruler of heaven descended to the earth, and thrones were set in place, and the Great Holy One sat down.
5.sourceText: ה֯א שלטן שמיא לארעא נחת וכרסון יחיטו וקדישא רבא ית[ב

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream
5.text: Hundreds of hundreds served him; thousands of thousands bowed before him.
5.sourceText: מאה מ]אין לה משמשין אלף אלפין לה [סגדין כ]ל֯[ ק]דמוהי

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream
5.text: All stood before him; books were opened; judgment was pronounced, and a great judgment was written and sealed.
5.sourceText: הוא קאמין וארו[ ? ספ]ר֯ין פתיחו ודין אמיר ודין [רבא בכתב כ]תיב וברושם רשים

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream
5.text: A great king ruled over every living thing and all flesh, and over all rulers. Here ends the dream.
5.sourceText: [מלך רבא ]ע֯ל כל חיא ו֯בסרא ועל [כל די שלי]טין עד כה סוף חלמא

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream
5.text: Then all the men and the giants were afraid. They called Mahaway and sent him to Enoch.
5.sourceText: [וארו ]ד֯חלו כל גבריא [ונפיליא ו]קרו מהוי ... ושלחוהי על חנוך

5.label: frg. 2 ii+6–12 — Ohyah’s dream
5.text: They considered and said to him: “Go to him […], so that he may tell you the interpretation of the dreams […].”
5.sourceText: [וחש]ב֯ו ואמרו לה אזל[...] ... די יחוא֯[ ל]כ֯ה פ֯[ש]ר חלמיא

5.label: frg. 7 ii — Mahaway reaches Enoch
5.text: frg. 7 ii — Mahaway reaches Enoch

5.label: frg. 7 ii — Mahaway reaches Enoch
5.text: […] like a whirlwind, and he flew with his hands like an eagle toward the east of the earth.
5.sourceText: כעעלעולין ופרח בידוהי ... כנש[ר למדנח ארעא

5.label: frg. 7 ii — Mahaway reaches Enoch
5.text: He passed over the inhabited land and crossed the great wilderness, and went far from them toward the Garden of Truth.
5.sourceText: וחלד וחלף לשהוין מדברא רבא [ורחק מנהון ליד פרדס קשטא]

5.label: frg. 7 ii — Mahaway reaches Enoch
5.text: He saw Enoch and cried out to him. Mahaway answered: “I have been sent […] to you a second time, so that you may interpret for us the two dreams.”
5.sourceText: וח֯זה[י ]חנוך וזעקה ואמר לה מהוי ... [אשתלחת] לתנא ולכה תנינות ... פש֯[רא לנא לתרין חלמיא

5.label: frg. 7 ii — Mahaway reaches Enoch
5.text: “We will hear your words, and all the giants of the earth […], so that we may know from you their interpretation.”
5.sourceText: למ֯ליך וכל נפילי ארעא ... [דברת די נ]נדע מנך פשרה֯[ו]ן

5.label: frg. 7 ii — Mahaway reaches Enoch
5.text: Then Enoch interpreted the dreams for Mahaway and said: “Concerning the gardeners who came down from heaven—they are the Watchers who descended […].”
5.sourceText: [באדין פשר חנוך חלמיא ... ואמר ... על גנ]נין די מן שמין נ[חתו אנון עירין די נחתו --]

9.label: frg. 1 — parallel to 1Q23
9.text: […] Ohyah answered and said to Mahaway […].

9.label: frg. 1 — parallel to 1Q23
9.text: […] “Were you not terrified by everything you saw?” […].

9.label: frg. 1 — parallel to 1Q23
9.text: [And he said to Ohyah:] “Baraqel my father was with me […].”

9.label: frg. 1 — parallel to 1Q23
9.text: […] Mahaway did not finish telling him what Baraqel had shown him […].

9.label: frg. 1 — parallel to 1Q23
9.text: [Ohyah answered and said to] him: “Behold, I heard wonders. If I have begotten emptiness/vanity […].”
9.sourceText: [וענה אוהיא ואמר ל]ה ארו תמהין שמעת הן ילדת ס֯רי֯[קה --]
